h1: Secret Santa and Stocking Stuffers Under $19
intro: This is the list I keep for the gifts that are easy to get wrong: the office exchange, the neighbor who takes in your packages, the stocking that needs one more thing in it. Twelve small pieces, each one chosen because it would honestly be wanted and used, not just unwrapped politely. None of them need a card to explain the joke.
seo_title: Stocking Stuffers and Secret Santa Gifts Under $19
seo_description: Twelve small Secret Santa and stocking stuffer gifts, each chosen for the person who is hard to buy for. Verified editor picks from Evergreen House.
list_card_line: Small gifts that get used, not politely unwrapped: twelve picks for stockings and the office exchange.

cards.B0FK4QL751: The joke gift that lands every year: a wooden ornament for the person who always saves the day.
cards.B0DXRKW3KY: Four flavors of the lip balm everyone keeps rebuying, so there is always one in a coat pocket.
cards.B09ZVNM5TP: Three hand creams that end up in a purse, a desk drawer and beside the sink all winter long.
cards.B0F3DPXQP1: Balsam and cedar, the smell of a tree lot, in a jar big enough to carry a whole room.
cards.B09BJ8ZSN1: Fuzzy cat paw socks that turn a drafty kitchen floor into the best part of a cold morning.
cards.B0D96YNNMP: For the coworker whose year was a lot: a mug that says it plainly and holds sixteen ounces.
cards.B07XXM6G7Q: A desk mug for the person who keeps the office running and needs reminding to leave on time.
cards.B0GT4WF7QP: Twenty four soft core pencils that suit a kid, an adult and everyone between, and never dry out.
cards.B0HNHPCRM8: A snarky Christmas coloring book for the friend who finds December lovely and honestly a bit much.
cards.B0HGGLTY4C: The one for the colleague who lives in meetings: pages to color while the agenda runs long.
cards.B0HNPKQLYZ: A coloring book for anyone in the middle of the change, with pages made for venting, not smiling.
cards.B0HHQRST9V: For the friend with something to get off her chest, one page and one pencil at a time.
